The '''Jedi Agricultural Corps research laboratory''' was a research facility located in the [[First Knowledge Quarter/Legends|First Knowledge Quarter]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Used by the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]], it included a number of large globes containing [[Alien/Legends|alien]] flora and fauna and several gardens.

[[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] used one of the laboratory's gardens to teach [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] a lesson in [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]]. Demanding that Dooku lift a pot that was situated in the middle of the path, Dooku concentrated to move the plant with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] alone. After successfully moving the pot into the grass, the apprentice was surprised that the pot sunk into the soft ground. Yoda informed him that the alien soil in the pot was extremely dense and heavy; the lesson taught Dooku that size or weight did not matter to the Force. Dooku recorded an account of this event in the [[Great Holocron/Legends|Great Holocron]], which became required reading for all apprentices over the last two decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force real-life book">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

The laboratories survived until the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], as his alter ego [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine, ordered the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|raid]] the Temple and kill all its occupants. Led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the troopers of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] ransacked the labs, leaving them in ruin.<ref name="ROTS" />
